subject: [RFC PATCH v2 02/18] splice: don't steal page cache folios

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Identified that removing code is always nice and suggested adding a description of the impact of this change. Raised questions about potential slowdowns and increased memory consumption.

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Provided additional context about the history of SPLICE_F_MOVE and explained that both fuse and virtio_console's splice_write() will now copy instead of stealing page cache folios.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This RFC patch proposes to remove the ability for splice operations to 'steal' page cache folios, which can lead to premature freeing of memory and potential corruption. The change involves dropping the ->try_steal function from page_cache_pipe_buf_ops and instead having SPLICE_F_MOVE copy the page cache folio directly. This approach is taken as it simplifies the code and avoids potential issues with writeback completion.
